title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-12-05
lineage: Sony F995 > Sony TC-124 > Master Cassette > PCM > DAT > CD > EAC > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a classic late‑60s set with Garcia’s countrified guitar and standout Black Peter & Baby Blue, despite occasional mic hiss and digi‑noise.
ai_review.review: The performance shines with Jerry’s sublime country‑flavored leads, a moving Black Peter, and a mournful Baby Blue that eerily foreshadows Altamont. The soundboard source is generally clear, though listeners note early‑song hiss from a loose mic plug and some digital noise on Me & My Uncle and Casey Jones. Overall the show outweighs the technical quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: Most reviewers rate 4‑5 stars, praising the musical set while noting only occasional recording flaws; the strong show quality and decent soundboard source drive a high combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Surprisingly clear for an AUD‑labeled master, but listeners report digi‑noise on early tracks (Me & My Uncle, Casey Jones) and a loose 1/8" mic plug that muffles the first couple of songs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A classic late‑60s set that builds to a poignant close with Baby Blue, capturing the era’s mellow vibe and occasional improvisational drama.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s countrified guitar tone is highlighted as sublime, with beautiful pedal‑steel‑like sounds.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is described as sweet and plainly audible throughout the show.
